name: Daisy Bottomley
title: Clinical Psychologist
description: I also have experience working with mood disorders, trauma, relationship and family issues, and drug and alcohol use. I provide couples therapy and have completed training in the Gottman Method. I am neurodiversity and LGBTQIA+ affirming, and welcome those from diverse cultural backgrounds. Modalities include CBT, ACT, Schema Therapy and DBT. Consults from Fitzroy North and Alphington.
specialties: LGBTQIA+ affirming, trauma, schema therapy, couples, anxiety, OCD

name: Dr Gillian Campbell
title: Clinical Psychologist
description: I enjoy working with clients experiencing depression, anxiety, substance use disorders, trauma, personality disorders, emotion dysregulation, and grief and loss. I have a particular interest in women's health, including relationship and intimacy difficulties, and recovery from intimate partner violence. I use CBT, ACT, Motivational Interviewing, Compassion-Focused Therapy and Schema Therapy.
specialties: trauma, schema therapy, intimate partner violence, intimacy, women's health, cancer

name: Ellie Woodrow
title: General Psychologist
description: I work with children, young people, and adults experiencing anxiety, depression, perfectionism, relationship issues, body image concerns, and substance use. I also enjoy working with people navigating their gender identity or neurodivergence. Primary approach ACT; also draws on CBT, DBT and schema therapy. LGBTQIA+ affirming practice.
specialties: gender identity, LGBTQIA+ affirming, schema therapy, neurodivergence, youth

name: James Lewis
title: Registered Psychologist & Clinical Neuropsychologist
description: I have a particular interest in supporting neurodivergent individuals, including adults with autism, ADHD, learning difficulties and executive functioning challenges, as well as adults living with acute and chronic health conditions, and LGBTQIA+ identifying individuals. James provides this support in ways that are affirming, strengths-based, and empowering.

name: Jason Eid
title: Clinical Psychologist
description: Interests: supporting neurodivergent individuals, LGBTQIA+ identifying individuals, acute and chronic health conditions; trauma informed. I work eclectically drawing upon ACT, DBT, CBT, and compassion-focused therapy, as well as incorporating concepts from schema and psychodynamic therapy. I hope to cultivate a therapeutic relationship where people can feel safe in bringing the entirety of their authentic selves.
specialties: LGBTQIA+, trauma-informed, schema, neurodivergent, health psychology

name: Jess Murphy
title: Registered Psychologist
description: I work with adults and adolescents through concerns including anxiety, low mood, trauma, grief and loss, identity exploration, and relationship difficulties. I have a particular interest and experience working with the LGBTQIA+ community, including supporting individuals exploring gender diversity and gender transition, as well as working with families of trans and gender diverse children and adolescents. Provides neurodiversity-affirming, trauma-informed adult Autism assessments with a focus on women and trans and gender diverse individuals.
specialties: trans and gender diverse, gender transition, LGBTQIA+, trauma, autism assessment, somatic

name: Justin Kelly
title: Clinical Psychologist
description: My practice is client-centred, trauma-informed, and strengths-based. I am neuro-affirming, sex-positive, LGBTQIA+ inclusive, and affirming of all relationship structures. I draw from Schema Therapy, CBT, Eye Movement Desensitisation and Reprocessing (EMDR), ACT, mindfulness, Motivational Interviewing, and CBT for insomnia. I've worked with clients diagnosed with PTSD and complex PTSD (CPTSD), and with intimacy and relationship difficulties.
specialties: EMDR, schema therapy, PTSD, CPTSD, sex-positive, LGBTQIA+, all relationship structures

name: Kate Willcox
title: Principal Clinical Psychologist
description: I enjoy working with both individuals and couples. I work with adults experiencing trauma, grief and loss, health concerns, life transitions, depression and anxiety, with a particular interest in people undergoing or recovering from cancer treatment, and women navigating PMDD, perimenopause and menopause. Consults from Fitzroy North and Alphington.

name: Laura Kennan
title: Clinical Psychologist
description: Laura has many years experience working with adults with depression, anxiety, postnatal depression, trauma, relationship difficulties, loss and grief and workplace issues. I draw on CBT, Schema Therapy, ACT, Mindful Self-Compassion and Gottman Couples Therapy.
specialties: schema therapy, trauma, couples, menopause, perinatal

name: Lauren Johansen
title: Clinical Psychologist
description: I work with adults seeking support in relation to depression, anxiety, trauma, life transitions, relationship difficulties and parenting, with specific interest in the antenatal and postnatal period. I draw upon relational and trauma-informed approaches. Listed areas include LGBTQIA+ affirming practice and Schema Therapy.
specialties: trauma, perinatal, LGBTQIA+ affirming, schema therapy, CAT

name: Manar Minawi
title: Clinical Psychologist
description: As someone with lived experience of ADHD, I strive to provide care that is both neuro-affirming and trauma-informed. I have experience with mood disorders, emotional regulation difficulties, complex trauma, and navigating identity as a person of colour in Australia. I am also trained in eye movement desensitisation and reprocessing (EMDR). Understands Arabic at a conversational level.
specialties: EMDR, complex trauma, culturally and faith-diverse clients, ADHD

name: Megan Macadam
title: Registered Psychologist (clinical and forensic)
description: I help people with a wide range of concerns, including trauma, anxiety and mood difficulties, phobias, and relationship challenges. I draw on CBT, DBT, ACT, Schema Therapy, and EMDR. Board-approved supervisor. Consults from Fitzroy North on Thursdays.
specialties: trauma, EMDR, schema therapy, eating disorders, LGBTQIA+ affirming

name: Nathalie Crawford
title: Clinical Psychologist
description: I support clients navigating difficulties with trauma, emotion regulation and chronic pain, with particular interest in eating disorders and body image. I incorporate elements of Schema Therapy, CBT and ACT; I provide trauma-informed care and use Eye Movement Desensitisation Reprocessing Therapy (EMDR) when helping people to process trauma. Consults from Fitzroy North and Alphington.
specialties: EMDR, trauma, schema therapy, eating disorders, chronic pain

name: Olivia Corda
title: Registered Psychologist, Clinical Psychology Registrar
description: I work with adults (18+) experiencing anxiety, OCD, depression, trauma, relationship challenges, and low self-esteem. I draw flexibly from ACT, CBT, Schema Therapy, and attachment theory principles. I practice from a trauma-informed, LGBTIQA+ affirming and neuroaffirming perspective.
specialties: LGBTIQA+ affirming, trauma-informed, schema therapy, OCD, perinatal

name: Ruby Bouhadana
title: Clinical Psychologist
description: I work with adults navigating anxiety, depression, complex trauma, emotional overwhelm and dysregulation, relationship difficulties, self-esteem difficulties, and burnout. My work is informed by Internal Family Systems (IFS Therapist Level 1), CBT, ACT, Schema Therapy, and mindfulness-based practices. I welcome all parts of a person's experience without judgment.
specialties: complex trauma, IFS/parts, schema therapy, attachment

name: Serena Thorpe
title: Clinical Psychologist
description: I have many years of experience supporting people through a wide range of mental health and life transition concerns, and I have particular expertise in working with complex trauma. Listed areas include Trauma & PTSD and LGBTQIA+ affirming practice. Also provides supervision to training psychologists.
specialties: complex trauma, PTSD, LGBTQIA+ affirming, bullying, parenting

name: Dr Zoe Vinen
title: Clinical Psychologist
description: Zoe draws on relational and trauma-informed approaches, as well as CBT, ACT and DBT. She has worked with clients with a range of identities and backgrounds, including neurodiverse, LGBTQIA+, and culturally diverse people. Particular interest in young people aged 18-25 and autistic and neurodivergent individuals. Not currently taking on new clients.

name: Clare Burton
title: Registered Psychologist
description: I am LGBTQIA+ aware and affirmative, and I strive to ensure everyone I work with feels respected and valued. I support adults experiencing generalised anxiety, perfectionism, depression, social anxiety, panic attacks, body image issues, trauma, relationship difficulties, anger management, grief, loss, and bereavement.
